notes: Capacity experiment: HR-DONK base is YOLOv8n; this run rebuilds on the official yolov8s-p2.yaml (scale s from the yaml scales dict) which adds a P2/4 detection head for symbols below ~8 px and widens the backbone.

initial_weights yolov8s_coco.pt transfers the COCO backbone and box-regression (cv2) rows via model.load(); classification rows do not match (COCO 80 vs 35 classes) and ClassNameTransferTrainer copies nothing for them, which is expected.
imgsz 1280 rather than 1536: the P2 head at /4 stride is memory-hungry; drop to --imgsz 1024 or --batch 2 if OOM.
Fresh-optimizer warmup: lr0 1e-3 (ultralytics AdamW default range) because the backbone starts from COCO, not from the v2 detector.

Run this AFTER v3_nano; adopt whichever wins on the unchanged detection_v1 validation manifest, then consider fine-tuning the winner once more from the balanced_v2 checkpoint if class-row transfer proves useful.
